name: infoklas
description: ІнфоКлас — веб-платформа для уроків інформатики (2–9 класи, НУШ)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @infoklas/server" "npm run dev -w @infoklas/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @infoklas/web && npm run build -w @infoklas/server
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test:rules: npm run firebase -- emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-klas-pult "vitest run --config firestore/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config tools/migrate/vitest.emulator.config.ts"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @infoklas/platform && npm run firebase -- emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,hosting --project demo-klas-pult "vitest run --config e2e/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm run test:rules && npm run test:e2e && npm run check:platform
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w @infoklas/platform && npm run firebase -- emulators:start --only auth,firestore,hosting --project demo-klas-pult
